jikan.title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 1: Futari no Hero Specials
jikan.title_english: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes Specials
jikan.synopsis:
Episode 1 is based on one-shot manga released in Vol. Origin, it explores the back-story of All Might's past and his journey into becoming the No.1 hero.

Episode 2 is an epilogue picture drama for Boku no Hero Academia the Movie: Futari no Hero.

Short specials included with the Blu-ray/DVD release of Boku no Hero Academia the Movie: Futari no Hero.
